title: Chance-Constrained Belief-Space Maneuver Planning for Autonomous Collision Avoidance Under Uncertainty
abstract: arXiv:2609.13428v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Increasing conjunction frequency in low Earth orbit places growing pressure on spacecraft operators to determine not only whether an encounter requires mitigation, but whether sufficient information is available to commit to a maneuver. This work formulates this information-action tradeoff as a belief-space planning problem for conjunctions between a maneuverable spacecraft and an unmaneuverable secondary object. The planner represents the uncertain orbital states as Gaussian beliefs and uses a chance-constrained belief-space Monte Carlo tree search framework to reason over possible future tracking updates before time of closest approach (TCA). A terminal chance constraint limits the probability of reaching TCA above a prescribed collision-risk threshold, allowing the planner to wait for informative tracking while intervening when deferral becomes too risky. We evaluate the approach on eight historical conjunctions from NASA's Conjunct

translated_title: 不确定性下自主避撞的机会约束信念空间机动规划
translated_abstract: 低地球轨道交会频率的不断上升，给航天器运营商带来越来越大的压力：他们不仅要判断某次交会是否需要规避，还要判断是否有足够的信息来执行机动。本工作将这种信息与行动之间的权衡表述为一个信念空间规划问题，研究对象是可机动航天器与不可机动次要物体之间的交会。该规划器将不确定的轨道状态表示为高斯信念，并采用机会约束的信念空间蒙特卡洛树搜索框架，在最近接近时刻之前对可能的未来跟踪更新进行推理。终端机会约束限制了到达最近接近时刻时碰撞概率超过预设风险阈值的可能性，使规划器能够等待更具信息量的跟踪数据，同时在继续推迟的风险过高时及时介入。该方法在NASA的八个历史交会事件上进行了评估。
tldr: 该论文提出一种机会约束的信念空间蒙特卡洛树搜索规划框架，能够在轨道交会场景中智能权衡“等待更多跟踪信息”与“及时执行避撞机动”之间的信息-行动决策。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a chance-constrained belief-space Monte Carlo tree search framework that intelligently balances the information-action tradeoff between waiting for informative tracking updates and committing to timely collision-avoidance maneuvers in orbital conjunctions.
